about: Receiving-water names in Georgia's spill reports (EPD's daily list, postings of 2026-06-01, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-30, 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03, and EPA's Sewer Overflow and Bypass Event reports for GA permits, extract of 2026-11-03) that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for GA, by name as typed (case and punctuation ignored). Spelling variants of a held water (Polebridge Creek, Sugar Crek, Ocmuglee) are listed as typed so an alias can be added.
